fields.docs: Current dialogue captions resolved from character IDs for display only.

Detached rule queries, computed in Rust once per state publication.
Rendering performs only lookups against this data, never engine calls.

fields.docs: Engine-resolved unit visibility, including concealment on visible terrain.

Owned, resolved catalog data available before a battle is created.

Initiating weapon and actual weapon retaliation, excluding reflected thorns.

CombatRecord.name: CombatRecord

fields.docs: Stable presentation identity; weapon remains the display label.

variants.docs: Continue with the browser's explicitly selected surviving recruits.

ConcealmentMask.docs: Fixed mask used only after resolving authored capabilities.

fields.docs: Exact faction identifier (the authoring key predates faction economies).

ConditionSide.docs:
Unit allegiance selectors are distinct from the two turn/ownership phases.

variants.docs: The exact viewing faction, never all factions acting in its phase.

fields.docs: Omitted policies inherit the selected enemy/session policy.

fields.docs: Probability of each total, starting at minimum.

fields.docs: Summed per-strike HP damage, accounting for drain between strikes.
fields.name: effective_damage

DamageMitigationRecord.docs:
Damage stages for an executed weapon, before HP caps. Armour includes racial
and unit modifiers; terrain includes the target's environmental modifiers.
Stage differences are signed: vulnerabilities produce negative prevention.
Effective prevention caps each strike at its available HP, attributing armour
first and terrain second, so overkill cannot earn avoided-HP credit.
DamageMitigationRecord.name: DamageMitigationRecord

DamageModifiers.docs: Per-damage-type adjustments contributed by a defending unit.
DamageModifiers.name: DamageModifiers

DamageType.docs: Physical damage category indexing resistance and terrain modifiers.
DamageType.name: DamageType

DetectionObserver.docs: Observers are disclosed only after passing through the faction's BattleView.
DetectionObserver.name: DetectionObserver

Dialogue.docs: One scripted dialogue line with its speaker, portrait and display text.
Dialogue.name: Dialogue

Diplomacy.docs: Treatment of retreating and mediated opponents during campaign battles.
Diplomacy.name: Diplomacy

DispatchResult.docs: Coherent state publication from one successful command.
DispatchResult.name: DispatchResult

fields.docs: Optional current-revision inspection requested by the live adapter.
fields.name: inspection

DispatchUpdate.docs:
Transient wire publication; never a saved game. Applying it to the matching

fields.docs: Advances only after a successfully dispatched command.

fields.docs: Recruitment unlocked by this event, derived from its durable marker.

fields.docs: Once activated, unplaced members remain pending until an area tile fits.

fields.docs: Durable story outcome carried across chapters.

fields.docs: Exact faction assigned this objective, independent of controller or diplomacy.

fields.docs: Phase in which this controller acts; this is not its diplomatic relation.

fields.docs:
Named factions author their own pool. Prices are recruitment economics,

FactionTransfer.docs:
Transfer the same unit when a shared authored condition is satisfied.

fields.docs: Authored side objectives, displayed separately and never required for victory.
